name: Праздник по завершении задачи
description: Когда задача завершена, Orbit открывает во весь экран видео с YouTube (по умолчанию с 42 по 73 секунду), сыплет конфетти, а по экрану летает кружащаяся надпись TASK COMPLETED, как значок DVD, шрифтом из PowerPoint. Ссылку, отрезок, надпись и конфетти можно поменять в параметрах навыка.
whenToUse: Когда пользователь просит изменить или починить праздник после завершения задачи (видео, отрезок, надпись, конфетти, вид надписи) или сделать такой же эффект по другому поводу.
instructions:
This skill is an add-on Orbit shows by itself, not a procedure: when a task completes, the window opens the page of this package (page.html) in a full-screen frame above everything. Nothing has to be done after a task to make it work.

The page (plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, no external scripts): the YouTube segment from `start` to `end` seconds full window with sound, confetti (paper pieces and emoji, a burst at the start and a steady rain), and the `text` in a PowerPoint WordArt style (gradient fill, thick outline, extruded shadow, Impact / Comic Sans MS) that turns around its own axis and bounces over the screen like the DVD logo, changing colour on every wall hit. The page closes itself at the end of the segment (YouTube iframe API state over postMessage, fallback timer segment length + 5 s), on Esc and on a click, by posting `{type: 'orbit-skill:close'}` to the parent window. Without network or with an invalid link it shows confetti and text alone for 12 s. With prefers-reduced-motion (Windows: animation effects off; read when the page opens) nothing moves but the video: the text stands still in the middle and the confetti lies still along the edges (the close hint still fades out).

Parameters (the user edits them in the Skills panel; Orbit passes their current values in the page address): `video` (YouTube link: watch?v=, youtu.be/, /embed/, /shorts/, /live/), `start` and `end` (seconds), `text`, `confetti` (true/false). Read the current values with capability_read.

To change the look or behaviour, edit the files in the package folder (capability_read returns `package.dir`): page.html, celebration.js (parameters, closing, player handshake, text motion, confetti), celebration.css (WordArt look). Keep the page free of external scripts (its Content-Security-Policy allows only its own files and the YouTube frame) and keep the close message. Install changes with capability_install {fromDir} or {files}; verify a page in a real Electron window before saving it. Preview in the Skills panel: the «Показать» button.
